title: LAST ONE IN THE CALL - Part 1
notes: Qwen3-TTS. narrator reuses VIDEO_008. Jay is only heard through the headset (fx phone).

narrator.ref_text: It was late, and the street outside was quiet. Somewhere a door closed, and I waited.

jay.design: Teenage boy, 16, energetic gamer talking to his friends on a headset, casual, fast and hyped; when scared his voice drops to a shaky whisper.
jay.ref_text: Yo, let's go! Did you see that shot? That was insane, bro. Okay okay, one more game, I promise.

lines.text: It's one AM. Your whole squad just left the voice chat. So who is still breathing in your headset?
One hour earlier, it's a normal night. You and the boys are playing Fortnite.
"Bro, you are cracked tonight! One more game!"
Then, one by one, they leave. Marcus. Then Dee. No goodbyes.
Now it's only you and Jay.
"Yo... did you hear that? Someone is knocking on my window."
Jay lives on the third floor.
"Bro. It's Marcus. He's outside my window. He's smiling."
A scream. Then silence. But Jay never leaves the call.
Your phone buzzes. A text from Marcus: Don't answer Jay. That's not him anymore.
In your dark monitor, you see your bedroom door. It's open. Someone is standing there.
Then, three knocks... on your window.
Comment A or B. Your choice decides Part 2.
